subject: 四层弟子立像 A（项目键迦叶，待核）

Neutral light-gray seamless studio backdrop, soft even diffuse illumination, sharp face and exact fingers, all in focus. Preserve the exact sculpted facial proportions, eyes, smile, body pose, garment folds, headdress, number of arms, hand positions and visible iconographic details of this specific reference. Material is realistic handmade ancient painted clay sculpture, mineral pigments and gilding, NEVER living human skin, wax, glossy plastic or cartoon/CGI. Clear shape separation suitable for 3D modeling. Isolate from temple, other figures, columns, halos not actually present, offerings and photographic clutter. No captions, lettering, watermark, panels or collage. Image is an AI interpretation, not documentary evidence; metadata outside image will say this. Long loose wide-sleeved cream robe with very eroded pigment and dark beige staining, bare feet on small lotus. Preserve modest face exactly; do NOT add elder wrinkles merely because filename says Kasyapa. Restore conservatively cream/tan robe and mild gold traces face only, no new ornament. Exactly two hands in prayer.
HYPOTHETICAL PRE-WEATHERING appearance: depict this exact sculpture freshly completed, before deterioration. Repair only damage, keep all original geometry. Continuous CLEAN paint surfaces, intact gilding where evidenced, NO weathering, NO dirt speckles, NO dark stains, NO chips, NO cracks, NO peeling, NO patina. Existing pale exposed ground patches on face/chest that clearly interrupt gilding should become continuous subdued gold. Preserve subtle handmade clay grain and brush texture, not distressed texture. Conservatively reconstruct only colors evidenced by surviving pigment; no arbitrary elaborate patterns, ornaments, fantasy jewels or newly invented objects. This is plausible pre-weathering appearance, not a claim of verified original Liao paint. Critical surface requirement: remove the reference's dirt and distressed look from EVERY surface including clothes, base and animal. Fresh continuous pigment; subtle handmade brush marks only. Use no artificial aging. Maintain realistic non-glossy sculpture finish.
